queries_run: Celestica customer concentration risk credit downgrade OR guidance cut 2026

findings.excerpt: We depend on a small number of customers for a substantial portion of our revenue. In the aggregate, our top 10 customers represented 79% of total revenue for 2025, 73% for 2024 and 64% for 2023. In 2025, three customers (all in our CCS segment) individually represented 10% or more of total revenue (32%, 14% and 12%).

findings.claim: 10-K風險因素：失去任一重要客戶可能對營運結果造成重大不利影響；無法保證降低客戶集中度的努力成功；CCS占2025合併營收74%。
findings.excerpt: A decline in revenue from, or the loss of, any significant customer could have a material adverse effect on our operating results, financial position and cash flows, and may increase the variability of our operating results from period to period.

findings.claim: 2025年Enterprise終端市場營收年減19%，原因為一家超大規模客戶AI/ML運算專案的技術轉換，顯示單一客戶專案轉換已造成實際營收波動。
findings.excerpt: Enterprise end market revenue for 2025 decreased $481.7 million (19%) compared to 2024, driven by the technology transition in an AI/ML compute program with one of our hyperscaler customers.

findings.claim: Q2 2026前三大客戶合計占營收63%，最大客戶占32%；集中度與存貨風險上升。

customer_concentration_credit.note: 搜尋未見2026年客戶信用降評、破產或Celestica下調指引的來源（搜尋摘要反而指出上調指引）；客戶信用惡化面查無來源。第三方摘要稱Q2 2026前三大客戶占63%、Q3 2026占66%，僅為二手整理，放入clues待核。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
